local_references.role: supplemental provenance; not counted as fresh remote transfer

categories.detail: Actual config, all 10 remote source files, original launch/attempt evidence and 39 approved local reference originals are preserved.
637 train, 91 blind valid, 182 blind test; raw hashes match the plan; all row identities and disjoint 573/64 internal split retained.
19 epoch records, 95 updates, epoch-11 selection and patience 8, configured learning rate and aggregate gradient evidence retained.
273 ordered blind predictions, all 910 rows of 2048-wide features and parse masks retained; all parse masks true.
Frozen backbone, initial/selected head, before/after frozen evidence, optimizer identity separation retained; only archive structure/CRC inspected.

Current 78 package METADATA/WHEEL/RECORD sets and pyvenv.cfg copied, interpreter hash read; original runtime/hardware snapshots and custom binary/source retained. Current metadata is not a training-time attestation.

All three CUDA/training attempt traces, stdout/stderr logs, prelaunch/resource observations, completion/exit evidence and local independent acceptance history retained. Retrieval itself had zero connection failures.

not_recorded.detail: 19 epoch loss records and cumulative step/gradient summaries exist; no per-batch time series was saved.
The original source predicts only blind valid/test; train features and official train labels are retained.
Initial head and the selected best head (epoch 11) exist; last stopped epoch 19 and other intermediate heads were not saved.
Optimizer separation, settings and step totals are saved; optimizer moment/state checkpoint is absent.
Seed 43 and split indices are saved; Python/NumPy/torch/CUDA RNG state snapshots are absent.
